data.title: Rejection of disability pension application
data.case_title: Rejection of disability pension application (Rentenversicherung Beispiel-Nordwest)
data.summary: Rentenversicherung Beispiel-Nordwest rejected Johanna Beispielacker's application for a pension due to full reduced earning capacity (Rente wegen voller Erwerbsminderung), stating she can still work at least six hours daily in light activities under § 43 SGB VI. An objection (Widerspruch) is possible within one month of notification.
data.explanation: The pension insurer has turned down your disability pension claim, finding that you are medically able to work at least six hours a day in light jobs, so you don't count as having reduced earning capacity under the law. You can decide whether to file a written objection (Widerspruch); the app will show the deadline for this. If you don't object in time, the rejection becomes final. You may also want advice from the Agentur für Arbeit on employment support, or a lawyer/Sozialverband specialising in social law (Sozialrecht) if you want to contest the medical assessment.

items.title: Decide on objection (Widerspruch) against the pension rejection
items.action: Decide whether to file a written objection (Widerspruch) with the Rentenversicherung Beispiel-Nordwest against the rejection
items.consequence: The rejection becomes final and binding if you do not object by the deadline shown
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid ist innerhalb eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe der Widerspruch zulässig.
